description: Defines interfaces and data structures for uplink PHY result notifications, including PRACH, PUSCH, PUCCH, and SRS results, and the notifier interface for handling these results.

classes.name: upper_phy_rx_results_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying uplink PHY decoding results such as PRACH, PUSCH, PUCCH, and SRS.

methods.name: on_new_prach_results
methods.description: Notify results of a PRACH preamble detection.

methods.name: on_new_pusch_results_control
methods.description: Notify results of a PUSCH control decodification.

methods.name: on_new_pusch_results_data
methods.description: Notify results of a PUSCH data decodification.

methods.name: on_new_pucch_results
methods.description: Notify results of a PUCCH decodification.

methods.name: on_new_srs_results
methods.description: Notify results of a Sounding Reference Signals channel estimation.
